properties.name: simba.jdbc.enabled
properties.description: Whether the JDBC backend is enabled.

properties.name: simba.jdbc.initial-delay
properties.description: Delay before the first JDBC contention attempt.

properties.name: simba.jdbc.ttl
properties.description: Time-to-live of a JDBC owner lease.

properties.name: simba.jdbc.transition
properties.description: Grace period for preferential JDBC owner renewal.

properties.name: simba.redis.enabled
properties.description: Whether the Redis backend is enabled.

properties.name: simba.redis.ttl
properties.description: Time-to-live of a Redis owner lease.

properties.name: simba.redis.transition
properties.description: Grace period for preferential Redis owner renewal.

properties.name: simba.zookeeper.enabled
properties.description: Whether the Zookeeper backend is enabled.
